title: Retire superseded contained hybrid retrieval implementation while preserving exact evidence
finding: After the packaged duplicate hybrid stack was pruned in G1-GARDEN-HYBRID-01, the already-merged PR #311 experiment still left a second live RelationStep/PathExpression/ContractionPlan planner, relation compiler, retriever, dedicated test and workflow in the current tree. The merged PR, exact commits and Git blobs already preserve the implementation as evidence, so retaining the executable experiment in-tree created unnecessary parallel abstraction and CI surface rather than unique evidence.
gardener_decision: Keep one concise evidence tombstone and the original machine-readable experiment packet in the live tree; remove the superseded executable experiment, its dedicated focused test and dedicated workflow. Do not move any of it into archive/legacy-20260830 and do not delete the PR, commits or blob evidence.

verification.repair: Remove the retired experiment path triggers and py_compile glob from the existing canonical Fourfold/Tensor workflow; do not introduce a replacement workflow.

The superseded experiment does not need a live second planner/retriever implementation to preserve this result.
